summary: Tested (1) the shadcn .dark class sync on <html> and (2) full onboarding narratif with new chapters (Ancrage, Bien-être, Action, Document). The dark class sync IS working (html.classList toggles between 'dark' and '' when the header ambiance toggle is clicked, confirmed by Moon<->Sun icon swap and dashboard visuals). However, the onboarding flow CRASHES with an uncaught TypeError when advancing from screen 8 (Inspiration) to screen 12 (Ancrage), because stepMeta is undefined for the newly-added screens 12/13/14/15. This blocks the entire new-chapter onboarding path.

ui_bugs.issue: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'tag'). The stepMeta lookup (lines 246-254) only defines entries for screens {4,5,7,8,9,10,11}. New screens 12 (Ancrage), 13 (Bien-être), 14 (Action), 15 (Document) are missing, so `stepMeta` is undefined and `stepMeta.tag`/`stepMeta.n` throw as soon as user reaches screen 12. Overlay is replaced by the CRA error overlay. Bloque tout le chapitre Ancrage et suivants.

Race condition on the FIRST click after login: html.dark class does not toggle on the first click (icon stays Moon, class stays 'dark'). Second and subsequent clicks work correctly. Likely due to prefsApi.get() finishing asynchronously post-login and overwriting the state set by the first click, OR the useCallback closure capturing initial DEFAULTS state. Reproduced consistently over 2 runs.

integration_issues.issue: Because of the stepMeta crash, none of the new chapters (Ancrez votre vision / Bien-être / 3 premières actions / Premier document) could be reached or validated. The screen 8 Nav points to setScreen(12) which triggers the crash.

action_items: CRITICAL: In /app/frontend/src/components/Onboarding.jsx, add stepMeta entries for screens 12, 13, 14, 15 (e.g. 12:{tag:'ANCRAGE',n:5.5}, 13:{tag:'BIEN-ÊTRE',n:5.7}, 14:{tag:'PREMIÈRES ACTIONS',n:8}, 15:{tag:'VOTRE DOCUMENT',n:9}) OR guard the render with `if (!stepMeta) return null;` and pick a fallback header. Without this fix, ANY user reaching Inspiration → Ancrage sees the CRA red 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay and the onboarding is unfinishable.

MEDIUM: Fix first-click theme toggle race after login. Options: (a) memoize toggleTheme via functional setter reading fresh prefs (setPrefs(prev => ({...prev, theme: prev.theme === 'light' ? 'dark' : 'light'}))), or (b) delay enabling the button until `loaded === true` from PrefsContext, or (c) do not re-set theme from server response once user has interacted. Observed: click #1 no-op, click #2 flips, click #3 flips.
critical_code_review_comments: Onboarding.jsx stepMeta is a fragile lookup; adding new screens requires manual sync — consider deriving from a single ordered array of screen definitions to prevent this class of bug.

PrefsContext.setPref uses `useCallback` with an empty dependency array — safe because setPrefs uses functional form, but Header.toggleTheme reads `isDark` from stale closure prefs. A functional patch (setPref((prev)=>...)) would eliminate the first-click race.
Onboarding.jsx exceeds 690 lines and mixes 15+ screens; would benefit from a router-per-screen split.
React StrictMode may amplify the toggle race since effects and callbacks are invoked twice in dev; also verify in prod build.

success_rate.frontend: 40% — theme sync core fix verified working (2/3 toggle clicks OK); onboarding new chapters 0/4 reachable due to crash

test_credentials: Magic-link with any new @example.com email (dev_link exposed since ALLOW_GUEST_LOGIN=true). Thomas via login-guest-btn for the theme portion.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Once E1 fixes the stepMeta gap (screens 12,13,14,15), re-run the onboarding flow with a NEW email. All new-chapter selectors (ob-ancrage-*, ob-energie-1..5, ob-action-0..2, ob-document-preview, ob-document-download, ob-document-drive) were confirmed to exist in the source but never rendered due to the crash. Also verify the theme first-click race is fixed by clicking the ambiance-toggle-btn immediately after login and asserting document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') flips on the FIRST click. Settings modal opened successfully and rendered — visual dark theme applied to overlay because .dark is now on <html> (see screenshot). Console had only 403/404 for static resources (unrelated).
rca of the issue: screen===12 rendered path enters the return() at line 258 which unconditionally accesses stepMeta.tag (l.265) and stepMeta.n (l.276, 280). The stepMeta lookup dict does not include keys 12/13/14/15, so lookup returns undefined -> TypeError. Reproduction: Fresh onboarding until screen 8 → click Sens ambiance → click ob-next (which calls setScreen(12)) → crash. Mitigation: add missing keys OR early-return null / add optional-chaining and fallback rendering for the new chapters (they don't need the 'ETAPE n/5' header).
